docs.title: OpenAI API
docs.text:
from openai import OpenAI

openai = OpenAI()
response = openai.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4.1-mini",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "System prompt"},
        {"role": "user", "content": "User prompt"}
    ]
)

        {"role": "user", "content": "User prompt"}
    ]
)

docs.title: Error: openai.AuthenticationError
docs.text:
Cause: Invalid or missing API key

Solution: - Check .env file contains OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-... - Verify key doesn't have spaces/tabs - Ensure load_dotenv() is called

Prevention: Use troubleshooting notebook to diagnose
